note: Four metrics are separate: discrete doubled-lattice mate identity, carrier incidence, continuous trim mismatch about N/2, and shell closure. Carriers stay frozen. Openings are not fitted. GPU is not used.

cubeB.note: Discrete mate identity is exact doubled-lattice equality f2B(i)=f2B(j) and dB(i)=-dB(j). Continuous geometricGap uses rotation about N/2.

frozenSolve.note: One Cube-B variable per mated sample, transformed about N/2. Carriers stay frozen. Incompatible pairs are reported, not snapped.
